(async()=>{const G=(await import('/js/flight/gtiles.js')).GT, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'); const out=[]; let last=performance.now(); const t0=last; const info=E.renderer.info; await new Promise(res=>{ const f=()=>{ const now=performance.now(); const dt=now-last; last=now; if(dt>80) out.push({t:+((now-t0)/1000).toFixed(2), dt:Math.round(dt), st:{...G.tiles.stats}, tex:info.memory.textures, geo:info.memory.geometries, progs: info.programs?info.programs.length:0}); if(now-t0<9000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); return JSON.stringify(out)})()
